name: Glimmerback
place: dungeon mine_descent SET B: floor 2's mini-boss (a 24 m gallery)
_doc: Stream E (M2). A living crystal growth in a dead gem seam. Three crystal growths stand in the gallery; when it fires its Prism Beam, every growth REFRACTS a beam of its own in a random direction. Its Shard Burst breaks growths caught in it — bait it next to the growths to thin out the reflections. P2 at 50% 'Overgrowth': new growths sprout (objects), a resonance ring, and refraction comes faster.
party: Solo: break the growths early with Shard Burst. 2-3: intended. 5: many bodies in a criss-cross of beams; the call-outs carry it. M5 scaling: growths 3 -> 2 solo; beam width down solo.

pull: The seam glitters, then stands up.
Light splinters across the gallery as something crystalline turns to face you.
say.death: Glimmerback shatters into a thousand worthless, beautiful pieces.
say.reset: Glimmerback sinks back into the seam, humming one high note.

enrage.say: The crystal sings so high your teeth hurt!

prism_beam.name: Prism Beam
prism_beam.say: Glimmerback focuses on {target} — and every crystal catches the light!

shard_burst.name: Shard Burst
shard_burst.say: Shards burst outward — anything nearby gets shattered!

overgrowth.name: Overgrowth
overgrowth.say: New crystals punch up through the floor!

resonance.name: Resonance
resonance.say: A ring of sound rolls out — get close to it!

phases.name: Overgrowth
phases.say: Glimmerback cracks and new facets bloom!
